scope: The original artifact hash manifests are retained unchanged. Only listed duplicate independent/root replay outputs are absent from the active public inventory. Every original smoke_v1 and calibration_v1 record is included, including all intermediate checkpoints and full/per-fit/aggregate update traces. Independent reruns can be regenerated in an isolated writable checkout; numerical and environment-dependent metadata have different reproducibility guarantees.

cache_exclusion: Regenerable Python caches are excluded. No cache is a scientific source dependency.
retained_data: Pilot: complete original smoke_v1, including all 25 checkpoints, aggregate and per-condition training traces, synthetic evaluation words/source tables, per-trajectory losses and proposal indices, cell metrics and profiles.

Calibration: complete original calibration_v1, including all 36 checkpoints, all 18,000 aggregate update rows and per-fit traces, frozen words/Q targets/shared minibatch indices, final predictions, checkpoint/final metrics, tail checks and audit addendum.
replay_boundaries: Both author runners have complete source/configuration inputs and refuse to overwrite an existing output directory. The public pilot PLAN.md differs only by declared internal-process prose edits, so its historical seal does not validate unchanged. Use the explicit isolated-copy preparation procedure: it verifies every selected exported identity, preserves the original seal as a separate historical file, and substitutes only the exactly mapped PLAN.md hash in the working seal. Do not reseal arbitrary inputs. Numerical arrays and CSVs can be regenerated; wall-clock/environment records can differ.

The unchanged pilot independent checker immediately loads its omitted independent_replay arrays. Reproduce that run into the expected location before running the full historical checker; retained final models and arrays otherwise support its final stress reconstruction.

The unchanged calibration independent checker has all 36 original checkpoints and every original ARTIFACT_HASHES entry available. Its original forward/metric/hash audit can run directly in an isolated copy. Only its optional independent-run comparison is skipped until review_independent/replay is regenerated.
Final models contain weights, not complete Adam optimizer state. Whole runs are replayable from seeds; exact mid-step continuation requires rebuilding optimizer history.
Original reports and complete original output directories are retained. This omission record excludes only redundant replay copies and caches, not original training records.
